jobs.title: Join Terrific - Builders Welcome
jobs.description: See something that should exist? Build it. See a better way? Do it. At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI. And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms. Commerce and media are rapidly evolving. Brands are moving toward interactive, real-time experiences where customers don’t just browse — they engage. At Terrific, we’re building the platform that enables this shift. Our technology allows brands, media companies, and creators to deliver live, interactive, and personalized experiences directly on their own websites and apps. We’re still early in our journey, which means the people who join now will help shape how the company grows and how the product evolves. If you like seeing opportunities and turning them into reality, you’ll likely feel at home here.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: See something that should exist? Build it. See a better way? Do it. At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI. And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms. Principal Engineer Terrific • Tel Aviv, Israel • Full-time, On-site/Hybrid About Terrific Terrific Live is a social commerce platform that helps retailers and eCommerce brands grow revenue through live, interactive, social-native shopping experiences on their own websites. Our platform connects audiences and shop presenters in real time — streaming to global brands, retailers, and media groups across Latin America, Europe, and Israel — and turns live moments into measurable sales. We’re hiring a Principal Engineer to set the technical direction of the platform, raise the engineering bar, and help us scale a 24/7, high-availability, AI-powered product to the next order of magnitude. The Role The Principal Engineer is our most senior individual contributor - a force-multiplier across the entire engineering organization. You’ll own architecture and technical strategy for Terrific’s platform end-to-end: real-time live video commerce, AI/ML-driven personalization, commerce integrations, data infrastructure, and everything in between. You’ll stay deeply hands-on — writing code, reviewing designs, and shipping critical systems — while also shaping how the team builds: standards, patterns, performance, and reliability. You’ll partner closely with the R&D managers, Product manager, and Design on the hardest, highest-leverage problems. What You’ll Do Technical Leadership Own the end-to-end architecture of the Terrific platform across backend, frontend, data, AI, and real-time systems. Drive engineering standards - code quality, testing, observability, security, and operational excellence - and raise the bar across the team. Mentor engineers; grow the technical depth of the organization. Design and implement new services and features end-to-end, from database to UI, with high performance and responsiveness. Build rapid prototype features A to Z. Tackle the highest-risk, highest-impact problems personally - live video reliability, real-time engagement, commerce integrations, and AI-powered experiences. Evolve our stack thoughtfully: React, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, GCP, Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub. Architect for global, 24/7 live operation — uptime, latency, cost, and graceful degradation during peak live events. Build for B2B2C scale: systems that serve enterprise customers (brands, retailers, broadcasters) and their consumer audiences across multiple regions and languages. Partner with Product and Data on experimentation infrastructure so every meaningful change can be A/B tested and measured. Partner with Product and Design from concept through launch, taking full ownership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Represent engineering with strategic customers and partners on deep technical topics; translate customer reality into architectural decisions. Make the whole team better - through design reviews, technical writing, mentorship, and hiring. What We’re Looking For 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a track record of leading at staff/principal level at high-scale products(!). Expert-level Node.js and TypeScript; strong frontend experience in React and/or Angular (both a significant plus). Deep experience designing and operating distributed, real-time systems in production, 24/7, under load. Strong data engineering instincts: SQL/NoSQL, event-driven architectures, and analytical stores (BigQuery or equivalent). Hands-on experience building or shipping AI/ML-powered features in production - personalization, recommendations, search, or generative AI. Experience on GCP (Firebase, Cloud Functions, Firestore, Realtime Database, Pub/Sub) is a strong advantage. Experience with commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce, and/or live video/streaming infrastructure, is a plus. Excellent judgment on trade-offs between scope, speed, performance, and UX; strong product intuition. Clear, calm communicator: writes well, pushes back thoughtfully, and makes the people around them more effective. Why Terrific Principal-level ownership of the platform that defines live, shoppable media. Real, global scale — top brands, retailers, and broadcasters, running 24/7 across LatAm, Europe, and Israel. A modern stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Angular, GCP, Firebase, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) with the autonomy to evolve it. A tight, senior team where product, design, data, and engineering ship together

jobs.title: Real Estate Creative Lead
jobs.description: See something that should exist? Build it. See a better way? Do it. At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI. And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms. Real Estate Creative Lead International, based in Israel · Content Strategy · Storytelling · Social Commerce Fluent in English and Hebrew required · Spanish fluency preferred THE OPPORTUNITY Real estate is changing. The future isn't static listings or endless property photos. It's content that educates, entertains, builds trust, and helps people make one of the biggest decisions of their lives. We're building a platform that helps real estate professionals create richer, more engaging customer experiences through video, social content, live experiences, and AI. We're looking for someone to define what outstanding real estate content looks like—and build the creative playbook that helps an entire industry create more of it. WHAT YOU'LL OWN The content strategy for our real estate vertical. A library of repeatable content frameworks, creative playbooks, and content formats that customers can easily adopt. Editorial planning and content calendars. Creative concepts, scripts, production briefs, and storytelling frameworks. The methodology that turns successful content into scalable best practices. Partnering with agents, developers, brokers, and real estate companies to help them create stronger content. Signature content campaigns and flagship creative experiences that showcase what's possible. The voice, tone, and creative direction of the category. WHO YOU ARE You are a proven content creator. You don't necessarily come from real estate, but you instinctively know what makes people stop scrolling. You think in stories, not posts. You know how to turn an idea into content that people actually want to watch, share, and remember. You're constantly studying what makes content perform. Whether it's Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, or the next platform, you spot patterns before everyone else does. You're curious, creative, fast, and AI-native. You enjoy building things from scratch more than maintaining existing processes. SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A complete library of creative playbooks and content frameworks for the real estate industry. Hundreds of reusable content ideas, templates, and formats. Customers consistently creating high-quality content using our methodology. Best practices that become embedded in our product and customer experience. Content that drives engagement, traffic, leads, and business results. Creative work that becomes a benchmark for the industry. WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT Most content roles are about creating posts. This role is about building a system. You'll help define how an entire industry creates content, develop the methodology that helps customers succeed, and create the frameworks that can scale across thousands of users. You won't just create great content. You'll help define what great real estate content looks like. מוביל/ת קריאייטיב ותוכן – תחום הנדל"ן ישראל | אסטרטגיה ויצירת תוכן | Storytelling | Social Commerce .שליטה מלאה באנגלית ובעברית · עדיפות לשליטה בספרדית ההזדמנות עולם הנדל"ן משתנה העתיד כבר לא נמצא בלוחות מודעות ובתמונות של נכסים בלבד, אלא בתוכן שמלמד, מעורר השראה, בונה אמון ומסייע לאנשים לקבל את אחת ההחלטות החשובות בחייהם אנחנו בונים פלטפורמה שמאפשרת לאנשי נדל"ן ליצור חוויות תוכן עשירות יותר באמצעות וידאו, תוכן לרשתות החברתיות AIלייבים ו אנחנו מחפשים את האדם שיגדיר איך נראה ת וכן נדל"ן מצוין, ויבנה את המתודולוגיה והכלים שיאפשרו לתעשייה כולה לייצר ממנו יותר תחומי אחריות הובלת אסטרטגיית התוכן של פעילות הנדל"ן * בניית ספריית Playbooks, פורמטים ותבניות תוכן שניתן לשכפל ולהטמיע בקלות * פיתוח פורמטים חדשים ותכנון לוחות תוכן * כתיבת בריפים, רעיונות, תסריטים ומתודולוגיות ליצירת תוכן * בניית שיטות עבודה שהופכות תוכן מוצלח ל-Best Practices שניתן לשכפל * עבודה עם סוכנים, מתווכים, יזמים וחברות נדל"ן כדי לעזור להם לייצר תוכן איכותי יותר * יצירת קמפיינים וחוויו ת תוכן שישמשו כהשראה לתעשייה * הגדרת השפה, הטון והכיוון הקריאטיבי של התחום * מי אנחנו מחפשים יוצר/ת תוכן מנוסה או בעל/ת ניסיון במשרד פרסום לא חייב להגיע מעולם הנדל"ן אבל כן חייב להבין באופן אינטואיטיבי מה גורם לאנשים לעצור, לצפות ולשתף :מישהו ש חושב בסטוריז, לא בפוסטים * יודע להפוך רעיון לתוכן שאנשים באמת רוצים לראות * כל הזמן לומד מה עובד בפלטפורמות כמו אינסטגרם, טיקטוק, יוטיוב ולינקדאין * משתמש בבינה מלאוכותית כדי לעבוד מהר, חכם ויצירתי יותר * אוהב לבנות דברים מאפס * סקרן, יצירתי ובעל יכולת ביצוע גבוהה * הצלחה בתפקיד בניית ספריית פלייבוקים ומתודולוגיות מקיפה לעולם הנדל"ן * יצירת מאות רעיונות, תבניות ופורמטים שניתן לשכפל * לקוחות שמייצרים תוכן איכותי באופן עקבי באמצעות המתודולוגיה * שהופכים לחלק מהמוצר וחוויית הלקוח Best Practices * תוכן שמייצר מעורבות, תנועה, לידים ותוצאות עסקיות * יצירת סטנדרט חדש לתוכן בעולם הנדל"ן * למה התפקיד הזה שונה רוב תפקידי התוכן עוסקים ביצירת פוסטים התפקיד הזה עוסק בבניית שיטה המטרה היא להגדיר איך תעשיית הנדל"ן יוצרת תוכן בעידן החדש, לפתח מתודולוגיות שיאפשרו ללקוחות להצליח, ולבנות כלים שיכולים לשרת אלפי משתמשים לא רק ליצור תוכן אלא לעצב את הדרך שבה התעשייה כולה תספר את הסיפורים שלה
